Area.evidence_source: Individuals intent on committing suicide, albeit ambivalentlyminded about it, consciously or unconsciously emit signals of distress, indications of helplessness, pleas for response, and opportunities for rescue in the usually dyadic interplay that is an integral part of the suicidal drama.; Wasserman (2001, p. 21) concludes that 'the manner in which other people respond to a person's suicidal communication may afford some protection against suicidal behaviour' but it could also add 'to the chaos and self-hate experienced by the suicidal person, accelerating the suicidal process in a negative direction'.
